title: India hit its 2030 clean energy target 5 years early
sources: PIB (Press Information Bureau, Government of India), 2025 - India crosses 50% non-fossil electricity capacity, 5 years ahead of 2030 NDC target
Enerdata, 2026 - India's FY2025-26 non-fossil capacity additions, record 55.3 GW
caption:
India just hit a climate target five years ahead of schedule. And it wasn't close.

More than 50% of India's installed electricity capacity now comes from non-fossil sources, as of June 2025 - a target that wasn't due until 2030 under India's Paris Agreement commitment. This past financial year alone, India added a record 55.3 GW of non-fossil capacity, the highest ever added in a single year, bringing total non-fossil capacity to over 283 GW nationwide.

Climate targets usually get missed or hit right at the deadline. Beating one by five years means the underlying build-out was moving faster than the target itself.
